summary: Spotify's AI DJ and AI-generated playlists are opt-in features that appear as buttons in the app. They are not forced into your feed — you simply don't tap them. There is no settings toggle needed; the features stay dormant unless you actively engage.

steps.path: Home feed → simply do not tap the AI DJ card or AI Playlist button
If AI DJ is playing: tap the three dots on the DJ card → Hide (removes from feed for that session)

whyTheyDidIt: Spotify is testing AI curation as a Premium differentiator but keeping it opt-in to avoid backlash.

sources.label: TweakTown — Spotify now lets everyone turn off videos across music and podcasts
